landing.documents: Start a blank document or open a DOCX, ODT or text file. Edit paragraphs, apply headings and lists, then download a copy in the format you need.
landing.spreadsheets: Create a workbook or open an XLSX, ODS or CSV file. Enter values and formulas, format cells and download your spreadsheet. Older XLS files open for viewing.
landing.presentations: Create a presentation, add slides and write titles, body text and speaker notes. Download it as PowerPoint (PPTX) or OpenDocument (ODP). Open an existing deck to read its slide outline and notes.
landing.pdf: Open a PDF to check its page count, author and title. Browse bookmarks, see which files are attached and inspect form field names and values.
landing.images: Open a PNG, JPEG, BMP or still WebP image. View it at its original size, rotate or mirror it, undo changes and export a PNG or JPEG copy.
landing.labels: Turn text into a QR code, Data Matrix, Aztec or Code 128 barcode. Arrange labels on printable PDF sheets or download artwork for product marks.
landing.signatures: Type a name to generate handwritten signature samples and choose a pen and ink. Fill in a stamp template and download the result as a PNG image.
ai.title: File assistant
ai.consent: To help with this file, OFF42 sends your request, the selection, a short outline and any text requested by the assistant to OpenRouter and its model providers. Cloudflare checks for automated requests and counts daily use using an anonymous ID and a daily IP hash.
ai.placeholder: Ask about this file or describe an edit
ai.limit: Today’s usage limit has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
ai.error: The assistant could not complete the request. Your file is unchanged.
ai.session: Start a new assistant session to continue.
ai.stale: The file changed. Send your request again.
ai.privacy: In the web document and spreadsheet editors, you can choose to use the file assistant. After you agree, your request, selection, outline and text requested for the task go through Cloudflare to OpenRouter and its model providers. OFF42 stores daily usage totals with an anonymous browser ID and a daily IP hash. Close the assistant or withdraw your consent at any time.
